stem_book: A 1 kg block rests on a smooth inclined surface of inclination 37°, held at rest by a horizontal force F (see figure; g = 10 m/s², sin37° = 3/5). The normal force between the block and the inclined surface is: (a) 15 N (b) 10 N (c) 7.5 N (d) 12.5 N
reason: Print says 'In above question' (Q5: force F to keep the body at rest); setup, smooth surface and g = 10 written into the stem.
work: along incline: Fcos37° = mg sin37° ⇒ F = 7.5 N; N = mg cos37° + F sin37° = 8 + 4.5 = 12.5 N
